_comment: PI6-s1 conflict-detection fixture. 8-dim baked section vectors + files: arrays per plan. Cosine is computed against the TARGET's section vector. Vectors are hand-authored so the AND (similarity >= 0.78 AND files-overlap) resolves EXACTLY and deterministically — no live model. TARGET is plan A.

plans.role: C: file-overlap only, cosine < 0.78 -> NOT flagged
D: similar only, NO file overlap -> NOT flagged
E: broad glob src/lib/** matches A's literal + >50% of index -> FLAGGED, broad overlap
F: literal src/lib/auth.js (used against E/G glob tests)
G: glob src/commands/** — no overlap with A's src/lib/auth.js -> NOT flagged
